notes: Pegzeus (PEGZ) is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its parameterless constructor mints 1,000,000,000 PEGZ once to msg.sender, the factory at launch. It has no external minting or privileged administrative functions and no transfer fees. There are no application contracts. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
